commit.message:
Compute struct/ustruct with fixed-size Eigen and reuse viscous response in linear elements

* Add a fixed-size fast path to double_dot_product

* Updated documentation for double dot product

* Compute dyadic product with eigen

* Updated documentation and removed references to Fortran

* Compute fixed-size tensor products with Eigen instead of nested loops

* Templated viscous stress functions on nsd and implemented fixed-size Eigen

* Updated documentation

* Trimmed comments from viscous stress functions

* trim comments and assume 27-node element bound rather than checking per gauss point

* Polished documentations, variable names, and types

* Removed column hoisting, which had no impact on runtime

* Dispatch by nsd within compute_visc_stress_and_tangent

* Reuse viscosity across gauss points for linear elements. lShpF corrected to false for wedge elements

* Reverted minor optimizations that made code less readable

* Declare viscous buffers as statics. Moved viscosity models into anonynous namespace. Improved comments

* recompute_visc flag checked in struct / ustruct instead of passed into compute_visc_stress_and_tangent

* Added nsd-templated compute_pk2cc overloads taking Eigen matrices

* Keep F, vx, S0, Dm, P and Svis as fixed-size Eigen matrices

* Fixed typos

* max number of nodes = 27 defined in consts.h

* Consolidate Matrix aliases into mat_fun

* refactor Bm as per-node Eigen blocks

* Hoisted and collapsed geometric stiffness computation with Eigen and created eigen view helper

* Removed unused locals in ustruct and collapsed more arithmetic with eigen ops

* Collapse rMNqx and rMNwx with Eigen

* Collapsed interpolated quantitied and gradients for readability using Eigen

* condensed strain displacmeent computation

* Implemented eigen view helper in viscosity models

* add compound assignments for consistency

* reverted two argument f + s to fl for fiber matrix

* removed dead locals and bare declarations

* aligned compute_pk2cc nsd branches for consistency

* Added comments to dyadic_product, eigen_view, and Kvis buffers

* Removed dead locals and moved declarations closer to use

* Organized prestress matrix to show voigt symmetry

* Refactored viscosity to simplify call site and hide Kvis_u, Kvis_v resizing

* Moved Eigen declarations closer to use

* Hoisted Fiber matrix construction out of gauss loop and cleaned up some Eigen expressions

* Remove dead mat_fun functions

* Cleaned up comments and out-of-scope edits

* Addressed review comments (constexpr, docs, mutable eigen view)

* Recompute_visc is now passed into visc.update()

* Removed Array overload of compute_pk2cc. Added eigen_view_rows helper

* Fixed bugs in post.cpp

* Updated unit test wrapper for compute_pk2cc to dispatch to templated eigen functions

* changed tpost to tensor_post

---------

Co-authored-by: Aaron Brown <71424733+aabrown100-git@users.noreply.github.com>

+/// @brief Viscous 2nd Piola-Kirchhoff stress and tangent contributions at a
+/// Gauss point, for the viscosity model configured for the domain.
+///
+/// Owns the buffers it computes into, so a kernel can hold one instance across
+/// an element's Gauss points and skip the calls it does not need.
+///
+/// @tparam nsd Number of spatial dimensions.
+///
+template <int nsd>
+class ViscousResponse {
+  public:
+    /// @brief Evaluate the domain's viscosity model at this Gauss point.
+    ///
+    /// Does nothing when recompute is false, preserving values from the
+    /// previous call. Used for linear triangules and tetrahedra for which
+    /// Nx, vx, and F are constant across the element's Gauss points.
+    ///
+    /// @param[in] lDmn Domain, supplying the viscosity model and its parameters.
+    /// @param[in] eNoN Number of element nodes.
+    /// @param[in] Nx Shape function spatial derivatives.
+    /// @param[in] vx Velocity gradient.
+    /// @param[in] F Deformation gradient.
+    /// @param[in] recompute Whether the stored values must be recomputed.
+    void update(const dmnType& lDmn, const int eNoN, const Array<double>& Nx,
+                const Matrix<nsd>& vx, const Matrix<nsd>& F, const bool recompute);
+
+    /// @brief Viscous 2nd Piola-Kirchhoff stress.
+    const Matrix<nsd>& S() const { return Svis_; }
+
+    /// @brief Tangent w.r.t. displacement. du(i*nsd + j, a, b) is the (i,j)
+    /// entry of the block coupling nodes a and b.
+    double du(const int ij, const int a, const int b) const { return Kvis_u_(ij, a, b); }
+
+    /// @brief Tangent w.r.t. velocity.
+    double dv(const int ij, const int a, const int b) const { return Kvis_v_(ij, a, b); }
+
+  private:
+    Matrix<nsd> Svis_;
+    Array3<double> Kvis_u_, Kvis_v_;
+};
 };
